add-task.description: Add a task card to a session: one unit of work, with a title, the prompt for the pane that takes it, and a stage. The card is kept by the daemon and saved with the session, so it survives the pane that added it and a restart. Who added it (by) comes from the connection.

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: title
params.description: One line that says what the card is, at most 200 bytes. Control characters are dropped.

params.name: prompt
params.description: What the pane that takes the card is to do, at most 16 KiB.

params.name: stage
params.description: The stage it starts in.

params.name: project
params.description: The repository the card is for, by its origin URL. It then shows on that repository's board in every session and on linked machines, and a pane on another machine can claim it with host. Omit for a card of the session only.

params.name: harness
params.description: The agent the card is for, such as claude-code. Pull dispatch gives it only to that agent. Omit for any agent.

params.name: ask_first
params.description: The card waits for a person to start it: dispatch never gives it to an agent.

params.name: machine
params.description: Where the card's agent starts: any for the machine place-agent picks, or a linked machine's name. Omit for this machine.

params.name: human_nonce
params.description: The attached client's nonce, to act as the person (by human). One that does not verify is refused with not_human.

returns.name: id
returns.description: The card.

returns.name: session
returns.description: Its session.

returns.name: title
returns.description: Its title.

returns.name: preview
returns.description: The first line of its prompt, at most 80 characters.

returns.name: stage
returns.description: Its stage.

returns.name: stage_at
returns.description: When it entered the stage, Unix nanoseconds.

returns.name: holder
returns.description: The pane that holds it: window, name, harness, state (read from the pane now) and held_at. Null when no pane holds it.

returns.name: by
returns.description: Who added it: human, shell, the adding pane's window id, link:HOST or plugin:ID.

returns.name: at
returns.description: When it was added, Unix nanoseconds.

returns.name: blocked
returns.description: reason, by and at when the card is blocked, else null.

returns.name: fan
returns.description: fan and fan_id, for a card added in a fan's session.

returns.name: attachment_count
returns.description: How many attachments the card has. Absent for none.

examples: {"id":1,"verb":"add-task","params":{"session":"work","title":"make the backoff jitter configurable","prompt":"Read api/retry.go and add a jitter option, with a test."}}

attach-task.description: Put a file or a link on a task card. The caller sends the file's bytes; the daemon never reads a path. A file is stored once by its sha256 and goes when no card names it. The kind is read from the content, then the name. The limits are [tasks] attachment_max_mib, attachments_per_card and attachment_session_mib. A pane changes the attachments of the card it holds, and of the card it finished while that card waits in verify or review; admin, the person, a shell, a link and a plugin change any card's.

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: id
params.description: The card, such as t1.

params.name: name
params.description: The name the card shows it by, at most 120 bytes; control and invisible characters are dropped. Required with content; a pull request link defaults to PR #N, another link to its host and path.

params.name: content
params.description: The file, base64 encoded. Pass one of content, files, link, screenshot and capture.

params.name: files
params.description: Several files at once, each name and content (base64): one change and one history entry. All of them fit one request line (12 MiB in base64).

params.name: link
params.description: An http or https address. A GitHub pull request's address is kind pr.

params.name: note
params.description: A line about it, at most 500 bytes.

params.name: replace
params.description: Put it in the place of the attachment with the same name. Without it a name in use with other bytes is refused; the same name with the same bytes is left as it is, so a retry succeeds.

params.name: screenshot
params.description: window (a pane of the card's session), scrollback and lines: the daemon takes a PNG of the pane and attaches it, named after the pane. A pane that calls needs the read grant.

params.name: capture
params.description: window, scrollback and lines (default 2000): the daemon takes the pane's text and attaches it. A pane that calls needs the read grant.

params.name: host
params.description: The machine that owns the card, for a project card from the pane that holds it there. The attach is passed on over the link; a picture or a text is taken here first. At most 3 MiB crosses.

params.name: human_nonce
params.description: The attached client's nonce, to act as the person (by human). One that does not verify is refused with not_human.

params.name: remote_window
params.description: Over the link only: the window on the calling machine that holds the card. Its daemon sends it; the holder's machine is the link's peer.

params.name: remote_name
params.description: Over the link only: how that window reads on its machine.

params.name: remote_harness
params.description: Over the link only: the agent that window runs.

returns.name: attachment
returns.description: name, kind (image, markdown, mermaid, diff, text, link, pr, file), media_type, size, hash, url (a link), note, by and at.

returns.name: attachments
returns.description: Every attachment the call named, as the card holds it now.

returns.name: unchanged
returns.description: The names the card held with the same bytes already, left as they were.

returns.name: task
returns.description: The card's row after the attach.

block-task.description: Mark a task card stuck, saying what it waits on, or with clear lift the mark. A blocked card keeps its holder and its stage, and claim-task next skips it. To let a card go, use release-task. A pane changes only the card it holds unless it holds admin; the person, a shell, a link and a plugin change any card.

params.name: id

params.name: reason
params.description: What the card waits on, at most 500 bytes. Required without clear.

params.name: clear
params.description: Lift the block. Not with reason.

params.name: human_nonce

claim-task.description: Take a task card for a pane: the card id, or with next the oldest card no pane holds that is not blocked or done, and that no fan of another session works on (fan with task). A card in todo or plan moves to doing. The pick and the take are one step, so two panes claiming next at once take two cards. A pane claims only for itself unless it holds admin; outside a pane, name the window. The card is released when its pane closes, its agent leaves the pane, or the daemon restarts.

params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: id
params.description: The card to take. Not with next.

params.name: next
params.description: Take the oldest open card no pane holds and that is not ask_first. Not with id. With none to take, the call fails with no_task.

params.name: window
params.description: The pane that takes the card, by id or name. From a pane, omit it to claim for that pane. Required outside a pane.

params.name: human_nonce
params.description: The attached client's nonce, to act as the person (by human). One that does not verify is refused with not_human.

params.name: host
params.description: The machine that owns the card, for a project card claimed, released or finished from the pane that works on it here. The call is passed on over the link for this pane.

params.name: remote_window
params.description: Over the link only: the window on the calling machine that holds the card. Its daemon sends it; the holder's machine is the link's peer.

params.name: remote_name
params.description: Over the link only: how that window reads on its machine.

params.name: remote_harness
params.description: Over the link only: the agent that window runs.

set-task-stage.description: Move a task card to a stage by hand. A pane changes only the card it holds unless it holds admin; the person, a shell, a link and a plugin change any card.
